payload.reason: Prior action ACT-93c1d8b802fa (targeting the compute process) was applied but independent recovery verification returned verdict=failed with reason=residual_process_or_persistence (target_absent_through_window=false, persistence_removed=false). Fresh timeline evidence confirms the recurrence mechanism: compute pid 9 stopped at 2026-09-20T01:30:52.053605Z and was restarted ~55.8 ms later as pid 20 with cause=supervisor, and the supervisor config /tmp/tmp51m3hgxz/host/compute-supervisor.json remains present=true with the same hash d935c4c7... and restart_seconds=1.0. Terminating the compute worker alone cannot succeed while this persistence entry re-spawns it, so the next action is to disable that persistence target to remove the cause of recurrence. The control workload (process:b66dc5f9966477a48ec040d0054e56bfc0b51ebb7221a54aa3516e2119709547, pid 8, heartbeat advancing) is not targeted and is left running.
